title: Efficient Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 高效的机器学习原子间势
summary: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 的精度接近量子力学参考计算，而成本仅为其一小部分。效率是多层投资计划的目的，但高效多层投资计划的策略尚未得到系统的审查。本次审查以效率为指导方针。为了在共同基础上比较 MLIP，我们用完整的基础扩展、原子簇扩展 (ACE) 及其图泛化 (GRACE) 来表示它们。该展开式是规范的，由单粒子函数的乘积构建。经典的原子间势（例如嵌入原子方法）和许多现代 MLIP（包括等变变压器）可以在此展开中表示。
abstract: arXiv:2611.22444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) reach an accuracy close to quantum mechanical reference calculations at a small fraction of the cost. Efficiency is the purpose of MLIPs, yet strategies for efficient MLIPs have not been reviewed systematically. This review takes efficiency as its guideline. To compare MLIPs on a common footing, we represent them in a complete basis expansion, the Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) and its graph generalization (GRACE). The expansion is canonical, built from products of single-particle functions. Classical interatomic potentials, such as the embedded-atom method, and many modern MLIPs, including equivariant transformers, can be represented within this expansion. Much of the apparent diversity of MLIP architectures therefore reflects how non-linearity, layer coupling and optimization are handled rather than which interactions the models can represent. We show how the cost of an MLIP becomes linear in system size and, at fixed rank of the tensor decomposition, in model complexity, and we discuss the role of machine learning, which provides non-linear parameterizations and optimization. Because efficiency is meaningful only at a given accuracy, we also compare accuracy and cost. On the Matbench Discovery leaderboard, models with three to five layers approach the accuracy of deeper models, and one basis, truncated along the Pareto front of error and speed, spans more than two orders of magnitude in cost. Ultimately, training data determine the quality of any MLIP.

title: Spin-Adapted Neural-Network Backflow Wavefunctions for Excited States of Strongly Correlated Open-Shell Systems
title_zh: 强相关开壳系统激发态的自旋适应神经网络回流波函数
summary: 基于分子基态神经网络量子态 (NQS) 的成功，自然激发态 (NES) 等多态框架 [Pfau et al., Science 2024, 385, eadn0137] 将 NQS 扩展到化学上重要的激发态。然而，如果不控制总自旋，此类计算可能需要包含其他自旋的许多干预状态，特别是在具有密集低能谱的强相关系统中。
abstract: arXiv:2611.22735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Building on the success of neural-network quantum states (NQS) for molecular ground states, multi-state frameworks such as natural excited states (NES) [Pfau et al., Science 2024, 385, eadn0137] extend NQS to chemically important excited states. However, without control over total spin, such calculations can require the inclusion of many intervening states of other spins, particularly in strongly correlated systems with dense low-energy spectra. We therefore generalize our previously developed spin-adapted neural network backflow (SA-NNBF) ansatz [Li et al., arXiv:2604.06841 (2026)] to improve its variational flexibility for excited-state calculations within a prescribed spin sector. We establish the universality of this extended ansatz within the chosen orbital space and spin sector, and use numerical benchmarks to assess how parameter allocation affects the ansatz's accuracy. With the spin-adapted ansatz, we are able to directly optimize the first excited state (a singlet) of O₂ without using any multi-state frameworks. Combining the extended ansatz with NES, we obtain low-lying triplet states of O₂ and singlet states of the [Fe₂S₂(SCH₃)₄]²⁻ cluster without including intervening states of other spins. Both the single-state and NES calculations achieve chemical accuracy relative to the exact energies. Our work provides a practical NQS framework for targeting excited states of prescribed spin in strongly correlated systems.

title: Stein Kernelized Molecular Dynamics for Active Learning of Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 用于主动学习原子间势的 Stein 核化分子动力学
summary: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 可实现高效、准确的原子模拟，但很大程度上取决于训练数据的质量和多样性。我们引入了 Stein 核化分子动力学 (SKMD)，这是一种增强的采样方法，它使用相互作用的粒子动力学来获取用于微调 MLIP 的信息训练配置。 SKMD 对应于 Stein 变分梯度下降的随机变体，通过合并异步粒子更新和全局原子描述符内核来适应分子动力学，这提供了构型相似性的对称感知测量。
abstract: arXiv:2606.04100v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable efficient and accurate atomistic simulations but depend critically on the quality and diversity of the training data. We introduce Stein kernelized molecular dynamics (SKMD), an enhanced sampling method that uses interacting particle dynamics to acquire informative training configurations for the fine-tuning of MLIPs. SKMD corresponds to a stochastic variant of Stein variational gradient descent that is adapted for molecular dynamics by incorporating asynchronous particle updates and a kernel of global atomic descriptors, which provides a symmetry-aware measure of configurational similarity. Unlike other enhanced samplers used in molecular dynamics, SKMD maintains the Boltzmann distribution as a stationary distribution of its dynamics in the appropriate asymptotic limit. This property enforces a balance between the exploration of diverse configurations and attraction toward high-probability regions of the energy landscape. We further propose an approach to efficient online data acquisition using an adaptive stopping criterion that selects non-redundant training data over the course of simulation. We demonstrate SKMD for the active learning of a neural network model of the Müller--Brown potential, a MACE interatomic potential for alanine dipeptide, and a MACE foundation model with a DFT oracle for predicting the Pandey reconstruction of the Si(111) surface. Compared to active learning baselines, our method achieves higher model accuracy in fewer training iterations.

title: Machine-learning interatomic potentials for battery materials: Defect-dependent lithium adsorption and local transferability on graphene
title_zh: 电池材料的机器学习原子间势：石墨烯上的缺陷依赖性锂吸附和局部可转移性

title: Data-driven reconstruction of band dispersion and quantum geometry via Koopman dynamic mode decomposition
title_zh: 通过库普曼动态模式分解数据驱动重建能带色散和量子几何
summary: 我们提出了一个数据驱动的框架，用于使用库普曼算子分析和动态模式分解（Koopman-DMD）重建能带结构。该方法不是从显式哈密顿量导出光谱，而是直接从时空数据（包括波函数和可观测量）重建能带色散和模态动力学。该框架在 Hamiltonian Floquet-Bloch 分解和 Koopman-DMD 之间建立了对应关系，由此提取的 DMD 模式对频率、衰减或增长率、空间剖面和投影权重进行编码。这些量允许重建谱函数、局域态密度以及离域到局域的度量，例如逆参与比。
abstract: arXiv:2605.06199v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a data-driven framework for reconstructing band structures using Koopman operator analysis and dynamic mode decomposition (Koopman-DMD). Instead of deriving spectra from an explicit Hamiltonian, the approach reconstructs band dispersion and modal dynamics directly from spatiotemporal data, including wavefunctions and observables. This framework establishes a correspondence between Hamiltonian Floquet-Bloch decomposition and Koopman-DMD, whereby the extracted DMD modes encode frequencies, decay or growth rates, spatial profiles and projection weights. These quantities allow the reconstruction of spectral functions, local density of states, and delocalized-to-localized measures such as the inverse participation ratio. Also, these extended DMD modes enable inference of quantum-geometric and topological properties, including the quantum metric, Berry curvature and geometric phases. Applications to prototypical one- and two-dimensional tight-binding models, including disordered Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model and its Floquet and non-Hermitian variants, graphene and Haldane models, demonstrate that Koopman-DMD provides a unified route for the data-driven analysis of wave propagation, localization, and topological phases in condensed matter, photonics, and related fields.

title: Dynamics and transport in LiF using classical and machine learned interatomic potentials
title_zh: 使用经典和机器学习的原子间势研究 LiF 中的动力学和传输
summary: 我们对熔融氟化锂进行分子动力学模拟，将经典的 Buckingham 和 Born-Huggins-Mayer 势与机器学习的原子间势 - MACE-MP-0b3（小）基础模型势及其微调版本进行比较。我们发现，开箱即用的 MACE-MP-0b3 能够准确地再现与可极化电势相当的液态实验剪切粘度，尽管它本身不是可极化的。以前使用经典势计算的粘度预测不足，这归因于熔化温度受到抑制。受此启发，我们比较了这些电势的熔点。
abstract: arXiv:2611.21900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We perform molecular dynamics simulations of molten Lithium Fluoride, comparing the classical Buckingham and Born-Huggins-Mayer potentials with machine-learnt interatomic potentials - the MACE-MP-0b3 (small) foundation model potential, and a fine-tuned version thereof. We find that the MACE-MP-0b3, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental shear viscosity across the liquid state comparable with polarisable potentials despite not itself being polarisable. Previous viscosities computed using classical potentials are under-predicted, which has previously been attributed to a suppressed melting temperature. Prompted by this we compare the melting points of these potentials. We find that the machine-learnt potentials address the significant underestimation of the melting point of the classical potentials, though the refined potential and the foundation model differ significantly between themselves. We probe the microscopic structure and dynamics of each model to further elucidate the considerable change in viscosity between classical and machine-learnt potentials. We find that, despite their lower melting temperature, classical potentials produce considerably stiffer, higher frequency, single-particle and collective charge-transport dynamics on account of their fixed charges. However, in the long-wavelength limit, the many-body machine-learnt potentials feature more elastic collective motion that governs the diffusion of momentum and is therefore responsible for the enhanced shear viscosity.

title: When Do Tensor Product Paths Matter? A Group-Theoretic Analysis of Equivariant Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 张量积路径何时重要？等变原子间势的群论分析
summary: 等变原子间势中的张量积 (TP) 层通过允许对称的路径对角度相互作用进行编码。然而，本地站点对称性可能会导致允许的路径在邻居聚合后不承载任何信号。我们称这种效应为聚合取消。在标量输入第一层中，完整位点对称轨道上的同种邻居共享标量和径向因子，从而减少了它们对球谐轨道和的角度贡献。如果受限的 l 度表示没有微不足道的分量，则对于任何学习的径向权重，该总和以及相应的路径都会消失。对于理想的 Oₕ 八面体轨道，这会删除 l_edge=1,2,3 类。
abstract: arXiv:2611.21683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tensor-product (TP) layers in equivariant interatomic potentials encode angular interactions through symmetry-allowed paths. Yet local site symmetry can make an allowed path carry no signal after neighbor aggregation. We call this effect Aggregation Cancellation. In a scalar-input first layer, equal-species neighbors on a complete site-symmetry orbit share scalar and radial factors, reducing their angular contribution to a spherical-harmonic orbit sum. If the restricted degree-l representation has no trivial component, this sum and the corresponding path vanish for any learned radial weight. For an ideal Oₕ octahedral orbit, this removes the l_edge=1,2,3 classes. Beyond the first layer, the factorisation no longer holds, so cancellation is no longer guaranteed; we instead ask whether affected paths remain less important on average. We test the two levels separately in NequIP: matched-radius TiO₆ probes examine first-layer cancellation, whereas a within-model CaTiO₃ comparison and six OMat24 models examine the importance bias. We then rank paths on training frames, choose the pruning fraction on validation frames, and evaluate frozen masks on held-out tests. At the highest evaluated fraction (60% of 174 paths), force mean absolute error (MAE) changes are 1.42%, 0.04%, and 1.83% for CaTiO₃, OMat24 Oₕ-cubic, and OMat24 low-symmetry data, respectively. The masks imply 67.12-71.94% potential TP-operation reduction and 59.77% potential edge multilayer perceptron (MLP) reduction; these are structural proxies, not measured speedups. The results connect local symmetry to path redundancy and pruning robustness in NequIP; transfer to other architectures remains open.

title: QCap: a physics-corrected graph neural network for the capacitance matrix of any planar superconducting device layout
title_zh: QCap：用于任何平面超导器件布局的电容矩阵的物理校正图神经网络
summary: 用于提取电容的器件布局电磁仿真需要大量计算，这是精确设计电路器件的主要障碍。机器学习模型可以绕过这些模拟，但以前的方法仅限于仅使用特定组件的布局，并且需要对这些相同组件进行数千次模拟作为训练数据。我们推出的 QCap 模型可以在几秒钟内准确预测任意超导器件布局的麦克斯韦电容矩阵，而 Ansys Q3D 仿真则需要几分钟到几小时。我们开发了一种新颖的设计嵌入算法，可将布局转换为通用图形格式，使模型能够与使用任何工具创建的任何布局一起使用。
abstract: arXiv:2611.22057v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electromagnetic simulations of device layouts to extract capacitance are computationally intensive, a major obstacle to accurate design of circuit devices. Machine learning models can bypass these simulations, but previous approaches have been restricted to layouts using only particular components, and require thousands of simulations of those same components as training data. We present QCap, a model that accurately predicts the Maxwell capacitance matrix of an arbitrary superconducting device layout in seconds, compared to minutes to hours of Ansys Q3D simulations. We develop a novel design-embedding algorithm that converts the layout into a universal graph format, allowing the model to work with any layout created with any tool. To achieve high accuracy, we obtain a coarse physics prior from a fast method of moments simulation of capacitance, then train the model to correct this prior. On 4,009 test designs withheld from training data the model outputs agree with Q3D simulations to a median error of 0.177%, and on never-seen component families it stays below 1% error. We demonstrate the model's scaling by obtaining the capacitance matrix of a 9-superconducting-qubit device in 12 seconds on a laptop (compared to 19.9 h and 228 GB of memory in Ansys) with sub-percent error, and capacitance of a (too large to simulate) 100-qubit, 781-conductor device in 3.4 min on a laptop. We provide the open-source models and data on SQuADDS and Hugging Face. Our results provide a powerful tool for large-scale accurate circuit design and guide the development of models to bypass other physical simulations.

title: Compositional neural networks for multimodal X-ray and neutron scattering inversion
title_zh: 用于多模态 X 射线和中子散射反演的组合神经网络
summary: X 射线和中子散射对于凝聚态物理和材料科学的结构表征是不可或缺的。然而，由于散射实验通常记录没有相位信息的强度，不同的结构可以产生相似的散射图案，从而使得相应的反演问题不唯一。通过组合互补测量可以减少这种模糊性，但将它们集成到机器学习框架中仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于先验摊销流量匹配的概率多测量分析的模块化框架。单观测后验估计器针对各个观测类型或物理探针单独进行训练，并仅在推理时通过组合采样器进行组合。
abstract: arXiv:2610.29362v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science. Yet, because scattering experiments generally record intensities without phase information, distinct structures can yield similar scattering patterns, rendering the corresponding inverse problems non-unique. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining complementary measurements, but their integration into machine-learning frameworks remains challenging. Here we introduce a modular framework for probabilistic multi-measurement analysis based on prior-amortized flow matching. Single-observation posterior estimators are trained separately for individual observation types or physical probes and combined only at inference time through a compositional sampler. This late fusion approach allows pretrained single-observation models to be reused without dedicated joint retraining. As a case in point, we consider reflectometry, which provides depth-resolved, nanometer-scale information about thin films and interfaces. Our single-observation demonstrations span X-ray, time-of-flight neutron and polarized neutron reflectometry. In separate co-refinement studies, task-matched estimators enable homogeneous composition across multiple neutron contrasts and heterogeneous multimodal composition of X-ray and neutron measurements. Together, these results establish compositional flow matching as a modular approach to uncertainty-aware inversion and co-refinement, with potential applicability to other scattering problems in which multiple observations constrain a common physical structure while retaining measurement-specific parameters.

title: Singular layer neural networks for the Navier-Stokes equations at small viscosity
title_zh: 小粘度下纳维-斯托克斯方程的单层神经网络
summary: 我们开发了小粘度 ε > 0 下二维不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程的神经网络方法，其精度在 ε 中是均匀的，并且其残差是在不解析涡度边界层的网格上评估的。在具有滑移边界条件的涡度流函数公式中，沿壁形成宽度 sqrtε 的涡度层。奇异层物理信息神经网络（sl-PINN）的试验函数包含渐近分析的校正器，以及固定其在壁上的振幅的定律。幅度与网络本身的壁迹相关，因此该方法不需要极限解的先验知识。
abstract: arXiv:2611.22072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop neural network methods for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations at a small viscosity ε > 0, whose accuracy is uniform in ε and whose residual is evaluated on a grid that does not resolve the vorticity boundary layer. In the vorticity-stream function formulation with the slip boundary conditions, a vorticity layer of width sqrtε forms along the walls. The trial function of the singular layer Physics-Informed Neural Network (sl-PINN) contains the corrector of the asymptotic analysis, together with the law that fixes its amplitude at the wall. The amplitude is tied to the wall trace of the network itself, so that the method requires no a priori knowledge of the limit solution. The sl-PINN keeps the error uniform in ε over six decades, for the Stokes and the Navier-Stokes equations alike, although in the latter the wall trace travels with the flow and is not known in advance. An enrichment that uses the thin scale but leaves the profile and the amplitude of the layer free deteriorates as ε→0. Since the corrector carries the layer analytically, the Laplacian in the residual can be discretized by a finite volume flux difference on a coarse grid. The resulting singular layer Finite Volume Neural Network (sl-FVNN) attains the same uniform accuracy as the sl-PINN, to within the scatter of the random seed, at about half the cost of a training step. The combination of the asymptotic corrector with the coarse-grid finite volume discretization is the main result of this article.

title: Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation
title_zh: Magflow：工业级 6D 磁悬浮的可微分模拟
summary: 六自由度磁悬浮原则上可以实现无摩擦运输和微米级定位，但由于其复杂且不稳定的动力学，低级控制本身就具有挑战性。工业系统通常依赖于深度的硬件-软件协同设计，其中动子和定子的几何形状被联合设计，以实现电磁力计算的紧凑、手工近似，从而保持控制在千赫兹速率下的计算易处理性。然而，这种方法对操作工作空间和支持的移动器拓扑范围施加了过于保守的限制。我们没有将底层物理简化为手工制作的近似值，而是直接计算物理。我们推出 Magflow，一种用于 6D 磁悬浮的完全可微分、GPU 并行模拟器。
abstract: arXiv:2611.23050v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic levitation with six-degrees-of-freedom enables frictionless transport and micrometer-scale positioning in principle, but low-level control is inherently challenging due to its complex and unstable dynamics. Industrial systems typically rely on deep hardware-software co-design, where mover and stator geometries are jointly designed to enable a compact, hand-crafted approximation of the electromagnetic force computation, thereby keeping control computationally tractable at kilohertz rates. However, this approach imposes overly conservative constraints on the operating workspace and the range of supported mover topologies. Instead of reducing the underlying physics to a hand-crafted approximation, we compute the physics directly. We introduce Magflow, a fully differentiable, GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation. It is used to train the first neural controller for an industrial-grade 6D magnetic levitation system that is learned purely from simulated physics. We show that the learned neural controller transfers zero-shot from simulation to real hardware while satisfying hard real-time constraints at 4 kHz. The learned controller achieves qualitatively new behaviors and even levitates a mover topology for which no hand-crafted solution exists. These results demonstrate that co-design is not a physical necessity for 6D magnetic levitation control. More broadly, control learning from simulated physics can find solutions beyond the reach of control engineering in demanding industrial domains. Source code and demonstration videos are publicly available at https://sites.google.com/view/magflow.

title: Neural Network Path Optimization for Finding Transition States on a Machine Learned Potential
title_zh: 用于查找机器学习电位的过渡状态的神经网络路径优化
summary: 过渡态控制着化学反应速率和结果，但定位它们仍然是计算化学中的一个核心挑战。双端搜索方法在给定反应物和产物结构的情况下寻找过渡态，但通常依赖于为密度泛函理论开发的离散路径表示，其中势能表面评估的成本很高。机器学习原子间势（MLIP）极大地降低了这种成本，并利用自动微分来有效地访问高阶导数。我们介绍了 Popcornn，这是一个通过使用并行自适应数值积分器优化 MLIP 上的连续神经网络路径来查找过渡状态的框架。
abstract: arXiv:2611.22272v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transition states govern chemical reaction rates and outcomes, yet locating them remains a central challenge in computational chemistry. Double-ended search methods find transition states given reactant and product structures, but generally rely on discretized path representations developed for density functional theory, where potential energy surface evaluations are expensive. Machine learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) dramatically reduce this cost and leverage automatic differentiation to access higher-order derivatives efficiently. We introduce Popcornn, a framework to find transition states by optimizing continuous neural network paths atop an MLIP with a parallelized adaptive numerical integrator. This combination eliminates path discretization artifacts, reduces hyperparameter sensitivity, and enables non-local optimization to overcome local features using second-order potential-energy-surface information. Popcornn consistently recovers more correct transition states than standard methods such as nudged elastic band and growing string, across MLIPs on thousands of organic reactions, establishing it as a robust, automation-ready method for high-throughput transition state search. Popcornn's infrastructure is flexible in path objective, integration strategy, and optimization algorithm, making it a practical tool and platform for investigating open questions in MLIP-based path optimization.

title: Synthetic Crystal Data Generation for Diffusion Pretraining in Material Property Prediction
title_zh: 用于材料特性预测中扩散预训练的合成晶体数据生成
summary: 基于扩散的预训练已成为一种强大的策略，用于学习图神经网络中的可转移表示以进行材料属性预测，而无需每个预训练结构的能量、力和应力等量子力学标签。然而，该方法保留了一个关键的依赖性：它需要位于势能表面局部最小值附近的结构，这些结构传统上是通过已知或物理合成化合物的昂贵的 DFT 弛豫获得的。这种依赖性限制了可用预训练数据的规模和结构多样性，导致晶体结构空间的大片区域未被探索。在这项工作中，我们将基于扩散的预训练与合成结构生成联系起来，以减少这一瓶颈。
abstract: arXiv:2611.22140v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion-based pretraining has emerged as a powerful strategy for learning transferable representations in graph neural networks for materials property prediction without requiring quantum-mechanical labels such as energies, forces, and stresses for every pretraining structure. However, the method retains a critical dependency: it requires structures residing near local minima of a potential energy surface, which have traditionally been obtained through costly DFT relaxations of known or physically synthesized compounds. This reliance constrains both the scale and the structural diversity of available pretraining data, leaving large regions of crystal structure space unexplored. In this work, we connect diffusion-based pretraining with synthetic structure generation to reduce this bottleneck. We introduce a synthetic data generation pipeline combining three complementary strategies: perturb-and-relax, generative sampling via MatterGen, and protostructure enumeration. Where structural relaxation is required, we use fast machine-learned interatomic potentials instead of performing a new DFT relaxation for each generated structure. We further compare a coordinate-denoising control with continuous-time variance-preserving (VP) and sub-VP diffusion objectives using a randomly initialized Orb-v2 backbone. The source comparison covers seven MatBench property-prediction tasks, and an eighth task, textttmp_gap, is included in the protostructure scaling study. Every synthetic-pretraining condition numerically outperforms random initialization on all seven source-comparison tasks. Scaling the protostructure corpus from 20k to 165k under a fixed 400-epoch schedule numerically matches or exceeds MP-20k pretraining on most tasks; because this protocol increases both data diversity and optimization updates, the result reflects joint data-and-compute scaling.

title: An open dataset of gas adsorption in deformable metal-organic frameworks for direct air capture
title_zh: 用于直接空气捕获的可变形金属有机框架中气体吸附的开放数据集
summary: 从潮湿空气中直接捕获空气 (DAC) 的工程经济且可扩展的工艺依赖于原子模型来从广阔的化学空间中搜索和识别有前景的吸附剂材料。机器学习已成为以高效而准确的方式预测材料特性的强大工具，但这些模型需要大量精心策划的训练数据。我们提出了 Open DAC 2025 (ODAC25) 数据集，其中包含约 15,000 个 MOF 中 CO2、H2O、N2 和 O2 吸附的近 6000 万个 DFT 单点计算。
abstract: arXiv:2508.03162v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Engineering economical and scalable processes for direct air capture (DAC) from humid air relies on atomistic modeling to search and identify promising sorbent materials from a vast chemical space. Machine learning has emerged as a powerful tool for predicting material properties in an efficient yet accurate manner, but these models require large sets of carefully curated training data. We present the Open DAC 2025 (ODAC25) dataset comprising nearly 60 million DFT single-point calculations for CO2, H2O, N2, and O2 adsorption in ~15,000 MOFs. ODAC25 introduces functionalized MOFs, high-energy adsorbate placements, and synthetically generated frameworks to maximize the versatility of models trained on the dataset. ODAC25 improves upon the accuracy of DFT calculations in previous works and applies engineering intuition from recent work regarding the treatment of adsorbate-induced MOF flexibility. We release state-of-the-art machine-learned interatomic potentials trained on ODAC25 and demonstrate their utility via Henry's coefficient predictions. ODAC25 enables MOF screening for DAC at a resolution previously unattainable.

title: Supercell periodicity biases octahedral tilting and energetics in high-entropy perovskite oxides
title_zh: 超晶胞周期性使高熵钙钛矿氧化物中的八面体倾斜和能量学产生偏差
summary: 在高熵钙钛矿氧化物 (HEPO) 的计算研究中，奇数周期超级晶胞（例如 3 × 3 × 5）通常用于等摩尔五组分组合物。然而，已知此类单元会限制八面体倾斜，因为它们无法适应所有标准倾斜模式（Glazer 倾斜系统）。这种限制对 HEPO 的影响有多大，其八面体对局部阳离子环境有反应，目前尚不清楚。在这里，我们表明超晶胞周期性系统地偏置计算的八面体倾斜和能量学。使用机器学习原子间势，我们比较了 13 个 HEPO 的奇数周期和倾斜相当细胞。
abstract: arXiv:2611.22313v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Odd-period supercells such as 3 × 3 × 5 are often used for equimolar five-component compositions in computational studies of high-entropy perovskite oxides (HEPOs). However, such cells are known to constrain octahedral tilting because they cannot accommodate all standard tilt patterns (Glazer tilt systems). How strongly this constraint affects HEPOs, whose octahedra respond to local cation environments, remains unclear. Here we show that supercell periodicity systematically biases computed octahedral tilting and energetics. Using a machine-learning interatomic potential, we compared odd-period and tilt-commensurate cells for 13 HEPOs. Odd-period cells yielded smaller and less coherent tilts and higher energies, even after configurational averaging. In ~1,700-atom cells, tilt differences persisted in all compositions and energy differences in most. The bias extended to defects, with lower oxygen vacancy formation energies in odd-period cells for strongly tilted compositions. Based on these findings, a simple design rule for equimolar supercells is proposed to lift this constraint.

title: MatOS: An Agent Operating System for Materials Research
title_zh: MatOS：材料研究代理操作系统
summary: 材料研究依赖于分散且不断增长的数据、知识和模拟工具，一项研究通常跨越文献分析、计算和实验等多天的工作流程。大型语言模型代理现在可以检索材料数据，操作模拟代码，并与自主实验室关闭设计-合成-表征循环。然而，用新功能扩展这些代理、让长时间运行的任务保持在正轨上并让它们从过去的任务和用户反馈中学习仍然很困难。在这里，我们介绍 MatOS，一个用于材料研究的代理操作系统，具有三个核心组件：（1）分层科学资产图，将数据、知识、工具、技能、角色和工作流程组织为可重用资产；
abstract: arXiv:2610.34203v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Materials research relies on scattered and growing data, knowledge, and simulation tools, and a single study often spans multi-day workflows across literature analysis, computation, and experiment. Large language model agents can now retrieve materials data, operate simulation codes, and close design-synthesis-characterization loops with autonomous laboratories. However, extending these agents with new capabilities, keeping long-running tasks on track, and letting them learn from past tasks and user feedback remain difficult. Here we present MatOS, an agent operating system for materials research with three core components: (1) a layered scientific asset graph that organizes data, knowledge, tools, skills, roles, and workflows as reusable assets; (2) a stateful adaptive workflow that runs tasks as explicit execution graphs with scientific checks, so that they can be resumed and traced; and (3) evidence-driven asset evolution, which revises these assets from execution records and user feedback. On ResearchClawBench, MatOS improves on the previously best-performing agent by 11.15% with the same base model and extends the cost-score Pareto frontier. With a common base model, it outperforms Codex CLI and Claude Code, exceeding Codex CLI by 2.13% on MatTools and 4.17% on SciAgentGym. In eight research cases, MatOS narrowed more than 30 million candidate structures to 97 solid-electrolyte candidates, identified 89 halide variants with higher computed conductivity than their parent structures, linked the force errors of 11 pretrained interatomic potentials to local atomic environments, and supported two new methods that reduce errors by 3.1% and 13.6% relative to their baselines. These results show that organizing research capabilities as reusable, evolving assets enables agents to carry out long, multistage materials studies. Code is available at https://github.com/DingyangLyu/MatOS.

title: Atomic-scale Imaging of Time Reversal Breaking Supercurrents in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈
title_zh: Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈ 中时间反转断裂超电流的原子尺度成像
summary: CuO2 基高温超导性的一个长期谜团是时间反转 (T) 对称性破缺的机制和后果。尽管理论假设集中于持续电子电流作为潜在原因，但这些对于直接实验探针来说是不可见的。最近，原子级超电流可视化技术的发展打破了这一僵局。在这里，通过对 Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈ 中电子态 N(r,E) 的能量分辨密度进行成像，我们寻找无序 d 波超导体中流动超电流的特定特征。
abstract: arXiv:2611.23060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A persistent mystery of CuO₂-based high temperature superconductivity has been the mechanism and consequences of time reversal (T)-symmetry breaking. Although theoretical hypotheses focus upon persistent electronic currents as a potential cause, these have been invisible to direct experimental probes. That impasse has recently been removed by development of techniques for atomic-scale supercurrent visualization. Here, by imaging the energy-resolved density of electronic states N(r,E) in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈, we search for the specific signatures of flowing supercurrents in a disordered d-wave superconductor. Employing the strategy of artificial neural networks (ANN) for complex quantum matter visualization, we designed a dual-ANN (VMAP) to efficiently implement d-wave supercurrent visualization, achieving imaging of supercurrent speeds V(r) at magnetic fields |B| ≤ μ T in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈. Correspondence between specific characteristics of N(r,E) around each supercurrent loop and a quantum "Rosetta Stone" which translates N(r,E) to V(r), emphasizes the validity of V(r) detection and visualization. Then, for hole-densities 0.17 ≤ p ≤ 0.22 we observe statistically repeatable networks of supercurrent flows. Crucially, these supercurrents satisfy Kirchhoff's law at junctions within each network. Further, theoretical predictions for supercurrent speeds V in disordered d-wave superconductors are consistent with measured 1250 m/s < V < 4000 m/s, and with reported magnetic field amplitudes |B| approx 0.1 mT Thus, detection and visualization of these supercurrent loop networks provides unique perspectives on T-symmetry breaking in cuprates. It also emphasizes the accelerating utility of ANN techniques for physics discovery from high data volume quantum matter research.

title: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
title_zh: 钙钛矿前驱体添加剂发现的闭环框架
summary: 有效发现前体添加剂对于提高钙钛矿太阳能电池的性能至关重要，但巨大的化学空间使得传统的试错筛选效率低下。在这里，我们展示了 LEAP（LLM 驱动的钙钛矿主动学习探索），这是一个将领域专业语言模型与主动学习相结合的闭环框架，在低数据条件下优先考虑钙钛矿前体添加剂。该模型从文献中提取与机制相关的知识，并将其转换为可解释的分子描述符，以进行不确定性贝叶斯优化。根据从未见过的文献进行的评估，专用模型比经过测试的通用模型提供了更多机制一致的答案。
abstract: arXiv:2605.20242v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Efficient discovery of precursor additives is essential for improving the performance of perovskite solar cells, yet the large chemical space makes conventional trial-and-error screening inefficient. Here we show that LEAP (LLM-driven Exploration via Active Learning for Perovskites), a closed-loop framework combining a domain-specialized language model with active learning, prioritizes perovskite precursor additives under low-data conditions. The model extracts mechanism-relevant knowledge from the literature and converts it into interpretable molecular descriptors for uncertainty-aware Bayesian optimization. On an evaluation drawn from unseen literature, the specialized model provides more mechanism-consistent answers than the tested general-purpose models. In an expert-guided proof-of-concept study, two later-round additives increase average device power conversion efficiencies to 20.13% and 20.87%, compared with 19.25% for the control, and the best device reaches 21.32%. Because only a limited number of candidates are tested prospectively, these results provide preliminary evidence that literature-grounded molecular representations, Bayesian optimization, and expert assessment can support additive discovery for perovskite solar cells.

title: DSADiff: Data Structure-Aware Diffusion for Crystal Structure Prediction via Mitigating Complexity- and Imbalance-Induced Biases
title_zh: DSADiff：通过减轻复杂性和不平衡引起的偏差进行晶体结构预测的数据结构感知扩散
summary: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是加速新材料产生和发现的重要一步。近年来，基于扩散的 CSP 方法取得了重大进展。然而，现有模型在面对不同的材料空间时仍然存在生成偏差，而追踪此类性能变化来源的系统方法仍然有限。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了LAS（分层分析策略），这是一种机制分析框架，将晶体复杂性和元素组成不平衡确定为影响生成难度的两个关键因素，并进一步揭示它们与模型生成性能的关系。
abstract: arXiv:2611.22050v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) is an important step in accelerating the generation and discovery of new materials. In recent years, diffusion-based CSP methods have made significant progress. However, existing models still suffer from generation bias when facing diverse materials spaces, while systematic approaches for tracing the sources of such performance variations remain limited. To address this issue, we propose LAS (Layered Analysis Strategy), a mechanism analysis framework that identifies crystal complexity and elemental composition imbalance as two key factors affecting generation difficulty and further reveals their relationships with model generation performance. Building on these findings, we further propose DSADiff (Data Structure-Aware Diffusion), a data structure-aware diffusion model that transforms the key factors identified by LAS into a unified generation difficulty representation and uses it to jointly drive feature modeling and training strategy optimization. This enables the model to adapt its representation and generation capability to samples with different data structures and difficulty levels, thereby mitigating learning bias across samples. Experiments on three CSP benchmark datasets, including Carbon-24, demonstrate that DSADiff consistently improves both Match Rate and RMSE, with a maximum Match Rate improvement of 9%, surpassing existing state-of-the-art methods and achieving new state-of-the-art performance. This work deepens the understanding of diffusion-based CSP models from the perspective of generation bias and provides a new direction for designing less biased generative models for complex materials spaces.
